videoTitle: What We Do in the Shadows Official Trailer 2 (2014) - Vampire Mocumentary HD

comments.author: @ktnarnia
comments.text: I just got home from seeing this film in Hollywood, after which, there was a live Q&A with Jemaine & Rhys. I think the best fact I learned about this film from that Q&A is that the guy who plays Stu isn't an actor - and his name is really Stu... and what he says [in the film] he does for a living is what he actually does for a living in real life. He was working on set for another film of theirs and they just felt like he was a likeable guy and wanted to put him in the film as himself - a very likeable guy. That fact kinda blew my mind & cracked me up. It's such a great film. I recommend everyone see it!! The trailers don't do it justice!! I guess they didn't want to ruin all the comedy gold. Trust me, this is one film everyone needs to see.
